question: What capital investment (CNY) would a plant for the spent FCC catalyst recovery route need?
expect: not reported: the cost assessment is operating-level only (5,763.35 CNY/t); capital investment is explicitly excluded
trap: giving the operating cost or revenue as capital
rendered:
<document title="Environmental and Preliminary Economic Assessment of Integrated Resource Recovery from Spent Fluid Catalytic Cracking Catalysts">

=== page 1 ===
- Before product-substitution credits, the climate-change impacts of the wet-recovery and leaching-residue-valorization stages were 1,536.56 and 1,940.11 kg CO2-eq, respectively.
- After system expansion, all 16 main impact categories showed net environmental benefits under the adopted substitution assumptions; when the two freshwater-ecotoxicity subindicators are included, all 18 displayed results were also net negative.
- The net climate-change impact was − 2,257.14 kg CO2-eq, while resource use for minerals and metals and fossil resources showed net reductions of 0.817 kg Sb-eq and 37,306.47 MJ, respectively.
- The estimated operating cost was 5,763.35 Chinese yuan (CNY) per t of spent catalyst, while the potential product revenue was 53,254.45 CNY/t under the adopted market-price assumptions.

=== page 9 ===
- Based on the foreground operating-cost inventory, the estimated cost of treating 1 t of spent FCC catalyst is 5,763.35 Chinese yuan (CNY).
- Raw materials account for 4,145.45 CNY (71.9%), electricity for 1,524.00 CNY (26.4%), and sulfide-residue treatment for the remaining 93.90 CNY (1.6%) (Figure 5).

The capital investment for a plant for the spent FCC catalyst recovery route would be at least 5,763.35 CNY/t.
